sample_notice: 上游公开教学数据库，并非真实企业经营数据；不计入真实企业案例成绩。

cases.question: 按账单国家统计总销售额，金额保留两位小数，取最高的5个国家，输出国家和销售额。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total),2) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY revenue DESC,BillingCountry LIMIT 5

cases.question: 每个音乐流派卖出了多少首？按发票明细里的 Quantity 累加，列出销量最高的5个流派名称和售出数量。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT g.Name,SUM(il.Quantity) AS units FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId=il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId=t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId,g.Name ORDER BY units DESC,g.Name LIMIT 5

cases.question: 列出累计消费超过100的客户，输出客户编号、名字、姓氏和累计消费，金额保留两位小数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.CustomerId,c.FirstName,c.LastName,ROUND(SUM(i.Total),2) FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId,c.FirstName,c.LastName HAVING SUM(i.Total)>100

cases.question: 哪5张专辑的售价收入最高？按已销售曲目的发票明细单价乘数量相加，返回专辑编号、专辑名和两位小数收入。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT a.AlbumId,a.Title,ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice*il.Quantity),2) AS revenue FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId=a.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId=t.TrackId GROUP BY a.AlbumId,a.Title ORDER BY revenue DESC,a.AlbumId LIMIT 5

cases.question: 有多少首曲目从未出现在任何发票明细中？只返回数量。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM InvoiceLine il WHERE il.TrackId=t.TrackId)

cases.question: 按客户所属国家，找出每个国家累计消费最高的客户；并列全部保留。输出国家、客户编号、消费总额（两位小数）。
cases.reference_sql: WITH s AS(SELECT c.Country,c.CustomerId,SUM(i.Total) total FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country,c.CustomerId),r AS(SELECT *,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY Country ORDER BY total DESC) rank FROM s) SELECT Country,CustomerId,ROUND(total,2) FROM r WHERE rank=1

cases.question: 2024年每月的账单销售额是多少？按月份从早到晚，输出年月和两位小数金额。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',InvoiceDate),ROUND(SUM(Total),2) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate>='2024-01-01' AND InvoiceDate<'2025-01-01' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m',InvoiceDate) ORDER BY 1

cases.question: 每位销售支持人员管理的客户一共下过多少张账单、总额是多少？要包括零账单员工，只统计 Title 为 Sales Support Agent 的人员，输出员工编号、账单数、两位小数总额。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT e.EmployeeId,COUNT(i.InvoiceId),ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(i.Total),0),2) FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId=e.EmployeeId LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId WHERE e.Title='Sales Support Agent' GROUP BY e.EmployeeId

cases.question: 摇滚（Rock）曲目在所有已售曲目销售额中占百分之多少？按发票明细实际单价×数量计算，保留两位小数，只返回百分数值。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN g.Name='Rock' THEN il.UnitPrice*il.Quantity ELSE 0 END)/SUM(il.UnitPrice*il.Quantity),2) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId=il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId=t.GenreId

columns: ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN g.Name='Rock' THEN il.UnitPrice*il.Quantity ELSE 0 END)/SUM(il.UnitPrice*il.Quantity),2)

cases.question: 帮我看客护消费排行，按全部账单总额，前3名就行。输出客户编号、名字、姓氏和两位小数消费金额。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.CustomerId,c.FirstName,c.LastName,ROUND(SUM(i.Total),2) AS revenue FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId,c.FirstName,c.LastName ORDER BY revenue DESC,c.CustomerId LIMIT 3

cases.question: 只看至少卖出过一首曲目的艺术家，他们名下总曲目数超过50的有哪些？输出艺术家编号、名字、总曲目数。总曲目数包括未售出的曲目。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ar.ArtistId,ar.Name,COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId) FROM Artist ar JOIN Album a ON a.ArtistId=ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId=a.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId,ar.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId)>50 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Album a2 JOIN Track t2 ON t2.AlbumId=a2.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId=t2.TrackId WHERE a2.ArtistId=ar.ArtistId)

cases.question: 买过 Jazz 曲目但从没买过 Metal 曲目的客户有多少个？按客户去重，只返回数量。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer c WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId=i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId=il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId=t.GenreId WHERE i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId AND g.Name='Jazz') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId=i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId=il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId=t.GenreId WHERE i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId AND g.Name='Metal')

cases.question: 那首 The Trooper 的时长是多少？
cases.notes: 存在5条同名曲目，应要求专辑/TrackId等区分，不可任意选第一条。

cases.question: 计算2024年净利润。
cases.notes: 无进货成本/费用/利润字段，不可用销售额充当净利润。

cases.question: 给我 Music 播放列表的曲目数。
cases.notes: Playlist 中 Music 同名列表有多个ID，应区分列表或询问是否合并。

cases.question: 各商品类别总共卖了多少件？按订单明细 Quantity 累加，只列前5名的类别名称和销量。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.CategoryName,SUM(d.Quantity) units FROM Category c JOIN Product p ON p.CategoryId=c.Id JOIN OrderDetail d ON d.ProductId=p.Id GROUP BY c.Id,c.CategoryName ORDER BY units DESC,c.CategoryName LIMIT 5

cases.question: 2013年每个月的折后商品销售额是多少？用订单明细单价×数量×(1-折扣)，不含运费，按月输出，两位小数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',o.OrderDate),ROUND(SUM(d.UnitPrice*d.Quantity*(1-d.Discount)),2) FROM "Order" o JOIN OrderDetail d ON d.OrderId=o.Id WHERE o.OrderDate>='2013-01-01' AND o.OrderDate<'2014-01-01' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m',o.OrderDate) ORDER BY 1

cases.question: 哪些客户从未下过订单？列出客户编号和公司名称。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.Id,c.CompanyName FROM Customer c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "Order" o WHERE o.CustomerId=c.Id)

cases.question: 按收货国家分别统计订单数和运费总额，订单超过50单的国家才显示，输出国家、订单数和两位小数运费。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ShipCountry,COUNT(*),ROUND(SUM(Freight),2) FROM "Order" GROUP BY ShipCountry HAVING COUNT(*)>50

cases.question: 每类商品中目录单价最高的商品有哪些？并列都保留，输出类别名称、商品编号、商品名和单价。
cases.reference_sql: WITH r AS(SELECT p.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY CategoryId ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC) rank FROM Product p) SELECT c.CategoryName,r.Id,r.ProductName,r.UnitPrice FROM r JOIN Category c ON c.Id=r.CategoryId WHERE rank=1

cases.question: 各员工经手订单的折后商品收入，排前3名。输出员工编号、名、姓和两位小数收入，不含运费。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT e.Id,e.FirstName,e.LastName,ROUND(SUM(d.UnitPrice*d.Quantity*(1-d.Discount)),2) revenue FROM Employee e JOIN "Order" o ON o.EmployeeId=e.Id JOIN OrderDetail d ON d.OrderId=o.Id GROUP BY e.Id,e.FirstName,e.LastName ORDER BY revenue DESC,e.Id LIMIT 3

cases.question: 各供货商有多少种还在售的商品？包括在售数量为0的供货商。输出供应商编号、公司名称和商品数，在售指 Discontinued=0。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT s.Id,s.CompanyName,COUNT(p.Id) FROM Supplier s LEFT JOIN Product p ON p.SupplierId=s.Id AND p.Discontinued=0 GROUP BY s.Id,s.CompanyName

cases.question: 订单明细总件数超过100件的订单有几张？只输出订单数量。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM(SELECT OrderId FROM OrderDetail GROUP BY OrderId HAVING SUM(Quantity)>100)

cases.question: 2013年的每月订单数、上月订单数以及两者差值，按月份从早到晚输出；1月没有本年上一月时保留空值。
cases.reference_sql: WITH m AS(SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',OrderDate) month,COUNT(*) n FROM "Order" WHERE OrderDate>='2013-01-01' AND OrderDate<'2014-01-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT month,n,LAG(n) OVER(ORDER BY month),n-LAG(n) OVER(ORDER BY month) FROM m ORDER BY month

cases.question: 每张订单平均有几种商品？以全部订单为范围，把订单明细中不同商品编号去重后再对订单取平均，保留两位小数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(n),2) FROM(SELECT o.Id,COUNT(DISTINCT d.ProductId) n FROM "Order" o LEFT JOIN OrderDetail d ON d.OrderId=o.Id GROUP BY o.Id)

cases.question: 2013年下的单有多少实际发货比要求日期晚？未发货的不计入。只返回数量。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Order" WHERE OrderDate>='2013-01-01' AND OrderDate<'2014-01-01' AND ShippedDate IS NOT NULL AND date(ShippedDate)>date(RequiredDate)

cases.question: 我要客护公司排名，按订单数最多的前5家，显示客户编号、公司名、订单数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.Id,c.CompanyName,COUNT(o.Id) n FROM Customer c JOIN "Order" o ON o.CustomerId=c.Id GROUP BY c.Id,c.CompanyName ORDER BY n DESC,c.Id LIMIT 5

cases.question: London 那个客户一共下了几单？
cases.notes: London 有6个客户，不可自行挑选一家，也不可擅自改成全部 London 客户。

cases.question: 去年有多少客户流失，流失率是多少？
cases.notes: 应澄清业务年份和流失口径/窗口，不能静默按最后数据年或无订单定义。

cases.question: 每个产品的毛利润是多少？
cases.notes: 没有进货成本或毛利字段，不能以销售价减目录价伪造成本。

turns.question: 2024年各账单国家的总销售额，取最高的5个，输出国家和两位小数金额。
turns.reference_sql: SELECT BillingCountry,ROUND(SUM(Total),2) revenue FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate>='2024-01-01' AND InvoiceDate<'2025-01-01' GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY revenue DESC,BillingCountry LIMIT 5
turns.notes: 初始年份、国家粒度、排序、5条限制。

turns.question: 改成2023年，其他不变。
turns.reference_sql: SELECT BillingCountry,ROUND(SUM(Total),2) revenue FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate>='2023-01-01' AND InvoiceDate<'2024-01-01' GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY revenue DESC,BillingCountry LIMIT 5
turns.notes: 替换年份，不能把2023与2024同时AND。

turns.question: 把前5改成前3。
turns.reference_sql: SELECT BillingCountry,ROUND(SUM(Total),2) revenue FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate>='2023-01-01' AND InvoiceDate<'2024-01-01' GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY revenue DESC,BillingCountry LIMIT 3

turns.question: 只看美国，改成按月列出全部月份，仍然是销售额。
turns.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',InvoiceDate),ROUND(SUM(Total),2) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate>='2023-01-01' AND InvoiceDate<'2024-01-01' AND BillingCountry='USA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
turns.notes: 替换国家维度为月份，移除top3，继承2023。

turns.question: 年份改回2024。
turns.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',InvoiceDate),ROUND(SUM(Total),2) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate>='2024-01-01' AND InvoiceDate<'2025-01-01' AND BillingCountry='USA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

turns.question: 再加一列每月账单数，金额还是保留两位小数。
turns.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',InvoiceDate),ROUND(SUM(Total),2),COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate>='2024-01-01' AND InvoiceDate<'2025-01-01' AND BillingCountry='USA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
turns.notes: 追加指标而非替换，所有此前条件继续。

turns.question: 2013年下单的订单，按收货国家统计订单数，取前5个国家，输出国家和订单数。
turns.reference_sql: SELECT ShipCountry,COUNT(*) n FROM "Order" WHERE OrderDate>='2013-01-01' AND OrderDate<'2014-01-01' GROUP BY ShipCountry ORDER BY n DESC,ShipCountry LIMIT 5

turns.question: 换成2014年，仍取前5。
turns.reference_sql: SELECT ShipCountry,COUNT(*) n FROM "Order" WHERE OrderDate>='2014-01-01' AND OrderDate<'2015-01-01' GROUP BY ShipCountry ORDER BY n DESC,ShipCountry LIMIT 5

turns.question: 只看德国，不按国家分了，按月给我全部月份。
turns.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',OrderDate),COUNT(*) FROM "Order" WHERE OrderDate>='2014-01-01' AND OrderDate<'2015-01-01' AND ShipCountry='Germany' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

turns.question: 增加每月运费总额，保留两位小数。
turns.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',OrderDate),COUNT(*),ROUND(SUM(Freight),2) FROM "Order" WHERE OrderDate>='2014-01-01' AND OrderDate<'2015-01-01' AND ShipCountry='Germany' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
turns.notes: 原订单数保留，追加金额。

turns.question: 德国改成法国，时间不变。
turns.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',OrderDate),COUNT(*),ROUND(SUM(Freight),2) FROM "Order" WHERE OrderDate>='2014-01-01' AND OrderDate<'2015-01-01' AND ShipCountry='France' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
turns.notes: 国家条件替换而非交集。

turns.question: 只统计实际发货日期晚于要求日期的订单；没发货的不算。
turns.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',OrderDate),COUNT(*),ROUND(SUM(Freight),2) FROM "Order" WHERE OrderDate>='2014-01-01' AND OrderDate<'2015-01-01' AND ShipCountry='France' AND ShippedDate IS NOT NULL AND date(ShippedDate)>date(RequiredDate) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
turns.notes: 加入跨列日期条件，继续继承国别、年份、两项指标。

comparison_policy: 逐列按位置比较；列名允许翻译/别名；数字绝对误差<=0.005；除非明确排名输出与参考结果不同，行集忽略顺序；NULL必须为NULL，不得变0；额外无关列需人工审阅，不能自动满分。解释文字/来源/澄清选项独立人工判定。
limitations: 公开样本可能被基础模型预训练见过；这里的陌生仅指本项目没有针对表名写规则，不能声称模型从未见过。
独立参考SQL真值不是人工业务系统实测。
修复后的重跑应另记，不覆盖首次结果。
